Return to the original upright relaxed stance. Do not lift both hands symmetrically.

Follow through at shoulder height, then lower the right arm to the original stance. The single right-hand flick is the clear focus, not a two-handed wave.

actions.motionPrompt: Two distinct alternating forward spell thrusts in one sequence. First the right hand draws back beside the waist and thrusts forward away from camera at chest level with a small right shoulder rotation. It retracts while the left hand thrusts forward more strongly a short beat later. The two separate right-then-left releases must be clearly visible, with coordinated elbows and a slight torso recoil after each. Both feet stay planted. Lower both arms and return to the starting stance. Do not raise both arms together.
